name: Reduce Story opening latency from Find Stories
description:
Opening a Story from Find Stories intermittently waits for seconds. Investigation found coordination overhead and optional Plugin content on the critical path; fuzzy matching itself took 2.66 ms for 70 Stories.

Measured details loading uses 11 separate coordinated acquisitions (22 fsynced lock temporary files). A controlled 2 s Git publication-gate hold made a Story read take 2.004 s. Injecting 50 ms per lock write made details take 1.207 s; the same reads in one coordinated snapshot took 123 ms. Quiet baseline details took 15–16 ms, so the original intermittent incident still needs lock-wait telemetry for conclusive attribution.

Fix: instrument lock wait versus held work; avoid same-Board context.use mutations and covered Board reloads; show core Story/config before optional rows/badges; batch bounded reads without weakening lock/recovery guarantees; reduce Story Linking full-Board scans and repeated Epic/Spec reads. Finder indexing is a related separate bottleneck: 102 acquisitions in this Data Root.

See Story Spec performance-report for the full diagnosis, measurements, source paths, fix plan and acceptance criteria. Scope is implementation of that plan with appropriate manual profiling and required regression checks. Keep same-Board/cross-Board navigation, freshness, invalid Plugin Data handling and ADR-0019 guarantees intact.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Plan revision required before implementation; plan is NOT accepted yet. 1. Do not hold generic coordinated scopes across Plugin row/badge/search callbacks (including chunk20 callbacks or Board badges). A held optional async callback would block Root mutations/edit-move-delete despite core rendering; fixed callback count/current Built-ins/ADR0044 precedent do not satisfy Spec bounded-read and fairness requirement. Batch known bounded data reads under service-layer control, invoke arbitrary callbacks outside the hold, and explain explicit yield/bounds. 2. Separate same-Board Local State avoidance from route/reset decisions: context.use must not mutate an already-current Board merely because root route is nondefault/explicit params. Preserve appropriate covered-Board filters/cursor and cross-Board behavior; enumerate same-context explicit-board/home/other-route cases. 3. No-test plan insufficient for changed coordination/read-scope and async freshness semantics. Propose minimal deterministic barriers in existing storage/Plugin/TUI test homes: publication-hold recovery/snapshot safety and telemetry, core usable plus a mutation progressing while optional callback is held, stale enrichment cannot replace a newer Story/reload. Extend kept tests where meaningful; at most one necessary new test keeps total<=100. No timing thresholds/sleeps/duplicate UI snapshots. 4. Deferring cache and Spec/Epic search deduplication may be justified after measured revised batching; demonstrate post-change71/501/Plugins-on-off/slow-storage and separate core/enrichment/index timings, full read/lock counts with measurement limits. Do not treat estimated29reads<1ms as post-change proof or claim original incident attribution. Telemetry must separate queue/publication/Root-lock/recovery/held work with operation names/durations only, no raw holder records/PIDs/hosts/paths/body data. Keep ADR0019 safety, no fsync/lock bypass. Revise plan and WAIT acceptance; research/harness work outside repo only. Resource and absent-selection audit acknowledged, no metadata backfill.
